statement: Every nonidentity finite-order element of the full pure three-cusp loop-outer group, including GT0, is an involution with global multiplier minus one. Its extension has exactly three kernel-conjugacy classes of sections, forming the cusp-incidence triangle, and every section centralizer has zero first mod-two cohomology. Its normalized conjugator f is an actual involution coboundary h inverse alpha(h), with h in the commutator subgroup.
where_proved: Part D, statement D.34; work/part_c/d34.tex; code/part_c/pure_involution_d34.py

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. All peripheral classes, cyclic quotient characters and section conjugacies are explicitly specified.
notes: The genus-zero cusp incidence graph of a pure involution with 2-adic multiplier minus one is an n-cycle, by the Brown bound and the unique relation among the n cusp homology vectors. A hypothetical plus sign at an odd prime q produces a pure involution on the cyclic (q+2)-cusp cover; deck conjugation would give an impossible order-q automorphism of that cycle. This proves the global sign in the entire pure loop group, not just the GT0 centralizer. Conjugacy to complex conjugation and full generation by the two inverted cusp conjugates remain unresolved; the proof states the exact pro-p comparison without identifying it with a full-profinite automorphism.
